neighbours.label: the digit 0 or 1 directly after a 4 in a number (410, 402, S0140, 4,000): citations, DOIs, phone numbers, measurements. The - pole is the other side of the same distinction: a 7, 8 or 9 after the 4 (1.48, 1470, 493)
